integrity: Analytic proof plus independent exact-rational enumeration of 223729 rooted forests and 72193 simple unicyclic graphs, with 273 moment comparisons. Computations are finite checks, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Conditional law for simple connected labeled unicyclic graphs at fixed cycle length. Earlier exact total-leaf marginal and fixed-root forest enumeration are not claimed as new; no unconditional covariance or multigraph extension. Historical-priority risk remains where a relevant full text was inaccessible.
title: Shallow–deep leaf dependence around the cycle of a random unicyclic graph
